entities.name: Gustave Eiffel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: French civil engineer (1832-1923) who designed the iconic Eiffel Tower for the 1889 Paris Exposition, as well as the internal framework of the Statue of Liberty. His pioneering work in metal construction, wind resistance calculations, and aerodynamics advanced structural engineering and made him a symbol of industrial-age innovation.
